skills.name: Groovy Dance
skills.description: Dances, casting good effects on allies.  *Hit Rate +50%  (10 sec) *Changes regular attacks to area attacks (10 sec)

skills.name: The kill is mine!
skills.description: Creates a hammer by bleeding from the wrist, then jumps and smashes it down onto the enemy.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Skill Resistance -50% (6 sec) *Makes enemy skills unusable (6 sec) *ATK x 4300% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: CHAINSAW MAN
abilities.description: CHAINSAW MAN Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase2
abilities.description: Gives a set chance of greatly increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed.  This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
